fields.name: Basilisk
special: Petrifying gaze: any creature meeting gaze makes DC 14 Fort save or is turned to stone permanently; even a reflection can petrify
Thick hide: immune to fire
Kills on crit: a natural 20 is an automatic kill, not just petrification

fields.name: Black Pudding
special: Acid: dissolves organic material (leather, rope, wood) in 1 round; metal in 1d6 rounds
Splitting: edged weapons split the pudding into 2 creatures each with half HD
Cold immunity, lightning/fire do double damage
Can squeeze through cracks 1" wide

fields.name: Bugbear
special: Surprise: surprises on 1-4 on d6 due to silent movement
Intimidation: creatures with fewer HD must make Will save on first round or flee
Leader variant: 5 HD leader commands group; add +1 to all attacks while leader alive

fields.name: Chimera
special: Breath weapon: each head can breathe 3×/day; roll d3 for type: 1=fire cone 30' (3d6 Ref DC 14), 2=lightning bolt 60' (2d8 Ref DC 12), 3=goat head gore (charges instead)
Multiple attacks: only limited to one breath per round
Regenerates 2 HP/round while any head alive

fields.name: Cockatrice
special: Petrifying bite: Fort DC 12 or turned to stone permanently on the SAME round as the bite (faster than a basilisk)
Petrifaction reversed by blood of cockatrice applied within 24 hours
Immune to own petrification

fields.name: Demon Type I (Barlgura)
special: Immune to non-magical weapons
Fire/cold/electricity resistance (half damage)
Gate (5%): summon another Type I demon
Darkness at will
Berserk: on wounds below 10 HP, gains +2 to attack

fields.name: Demon Type II (Hezrou)
special: Immune to non-magical weapons
Stench: all within 10' make Fort DC 13 each round or are nauseated (-2 to all rolls)
Gate (15%): summon a Type I or II demon
Telepathy 100'
Cannot be turned by clerics below 5th level

fields.name: Demon Type III (Glabrezu)
special: Immune to non-magical weapons
Can grant wishes (3×): wishes are corrupted and cost the recipient
Reverse gravity at will
Dispel magic at will (caster level 9)
Gate (20%): summon 1-2 Type I, one Type II, or one Type III

fields.name: Dragonborn (Red Dragon Hatchling)
special: Fire breath (2×/day): 20' cone, 2d6 fire, Ref DC 10 for half
Immune to fire
Will grow: at 6 HD becomes a young red dragon (see full dragon entry)
Magic use: 5% chance each level of manifesting minor spells

fields.name: Fire Giant
special: Fire immunity
Hurl boulders: range 200', no penalty
Extraordinary strength: can uproot trees, collapse walls on successful attack roll
Berserker fury: when below half HP, gains extra attack

fields.name: Frost Giant
special: Cold immunity
Vulnerable to fire (+2 damage per die)
Hurl boulders: 150' range
Blizzard howl: once/battle, Fort DC 14 or all within 30' suffer -2 to rolls for 1 turn from cold shock

fields.name: Gelatinous Cube
special: Engulf: on hit, target must make Ref DC 12 or be engulfed — takes 2d6 acid/round and is paralyzed
Transparent: surprised on 1-5 on d6 unless actively searching
Immune to lightning, cold, acid

fields.name: Ghoul
special: Paralyzing touch: Fort DC 13 or paralyzed 1d4 turns (elves immune)
Undead immunities: immune to sleep, charm, hold
Pack tactics: +1 to attack per additional ghoul in melee with same target
Stench: Fort DC 11 or -1 to attack while adjacent

fields.name: Harpy
special: Captivating song: all within 300' who can hear must make Will DC 13 or be compelled to walk toward harpy (can't attack)
Resistances: none special but song works through walls if heard
Song breaks on harpy attack or creature taking damage

fields.name: Hellhound
special: Fire breath (1×/round): 10' cone, 3d6 fire, Ref DC 13 for half
Fire immunity
Can sense invisible or ethereal creatures by heat
Loyal to master: morale never breaks if master within 60'

fields.name: Hydra
special: Multiple heads: starts with 5–12 (roll 1d8+4) heads; each head can attack each round
Severing heads: cutting a head off requires 6+ damage to a head in one strike; otherwise it regrows in 1 round (2 heads on natural 20 cut)
Fire/acid prevents regrowth
Each head has 8 HP; body has full HP

fields.name: Invisible Stalker
special: Permanent invisibility: only see with true seeing, dust of revealing, etc.
Perfect tracking: can track any assigned target across any distance, any plane
Resentful: on 20+ concentration, stalker may deliberately fail on 1d20=1 (secretly)
Wind form: can pass through any crack or opening

fields.name: Kobold
special: Cunning traps: 60% chance any corridor has a kobold trap (DC 12 Ref or 1d6 damage)
Pack: +1 attack per 3 additional kobolds in melee
Daylight sensitivity: -1 to attack in bright light
Alarm cry: kobolds 3× normal hearing range for detecting intruders

fields.name: Lich
special: Paralyzing touch: Fort DC 16 or paralyzed 1d4 turns, even on miss (aura)
Undead immunities: immune to cold, electricity, polymorph, sleep, charm, fear
Level 11+ wizard spells: has at minimum 6th-level spells available
Phylactery: Lich cannot die while phylactery is intact; reform in 1d10 days
Fear aura: all within 10' must make Will DC 15 or be shaken (-2 to all rolls)

fields.name: Lizard Man
special: Aquatic advantage: +2 to all rolls in or near water
Hold breath: 15 minutes
Pack hunter: +1 attack per 2 additional lizard men targeting same creature
Ambush: surprise on 1-4 when in swampy terrain

fields.name: Manticore
special: Tail spikes: fire up to 6 spikes per round, each at +4 for 1d6 damage; range 60'; regenerate 12 spikes per day
Roar: once/battle, creatures within 30' must make Will DC 13 or be shaken 1 round
Intelligence: manticores plot and lie; may negotiate

fields.name: Medusa
special: Petrifying gaze: any creature meeting eyes must Fort DC 14 or be turned to stone; averting eyes imposes -4 to attack
Venomous hair: any creature within 5' must Fort DC 12 or take 1d6 Str damage
Reflection: a polished mirror shows medusa's gaze and it applies to her
Venomous bite through hair: +4 for 1d4 + Fort DC 12 or 2d6 Str

fields.name: Mummy
special: Mummy rot: Fort DC 14 or contract mummy rot — lose 1 point of Str each day until cured by Remove Curse; death if Str reaches 0
Undead immunities
Vulnerable to fire: takes double damage from fire; if on fire, must make Fort DC 12 each round or attacks are wild
Fear: creatures under 4 HD must make Will DC 11 or flee on sight

fields.name: Ogre
special: Throw rocks: range 30', +3 for 1d8
Bellowing charge: on first round of combat, free charge attack at +2
Dim but memorable: can be bribed with food (Fort DC 8 to resist a good meal offer)
Ogre mage variant: 5 HD, can cast levitate/darkness/polymorph self 1×/day each

fields.name: Roc
special: Carry prey: on two talon hits same target in one round, creature is snatched (Str DC 18 to break free)
Dive bomb: once/battle, dive at double speed for double damage with talons
Egg possession: adults with eggs are permanently enraged (+2 attack/damage)

fields.name: Salamander (Fire)
special: Fire immunity
Constrict: on hit with tail, target must Fort DC 14 or take automatic constrict damage each round
Heat aura: all within 5' take 1d6 fire/round
Metal heating: metal weapons that hit a salamander deal only 1 point of damage as they melt; caster takes 1d6 fire

fields.name: Shadow
special: Strength drain: each hit drains 1d4 Str (Fort DC 12 halves); death if Str reaches 0
Undead: create spawn from Str-drained victims
Only damaged by magic and silver weapons
Stealth: move silently in darkness, 95% undetected

fields.name: Stone Giant
special: Hurl boulders: 300' range
Catch boulders: on successful Ref save can catch incoming boulders and throw back
Rocky camouflage: surprise on 1-3 when in rocky terrain
Stonesense: detect vibrations through stone floor 60'

fields.name: Treant
special: Animate trees: call 1d2 trees within 60' to fight (treat as 3 HD creatures dealing 2d6)
Fire vulnerability: takes +2 damage per die from fire
Old growth: ancient treants (12+ HD) can speak to trees across entire forest
Trample: can move through small creatures dealing 1d12 each

fields.name: Wyvern
special: Poison sting: Fort DC 14 or 2d6 Con damage (Fort DC 14 again in 1 round or death)
Fly-by attack: can attack and move full fly speed in same round
Snatch on two talon hits: same as roc snatching

fields.name: Abyssal Larva
special: Soul rot: Fort DC 10 each hit or lose 1 point of Luck permanently
Wriggling mass: treat as a swarm (immune to individual weapons; area effects deal full damage)
Larvae are the damned: killing one permanently removes it from the cycle of souls

fields.name: Bone Devil (Osyluth)
special: Poison sting: Fort DC 14 or 3d6 Str damage over 1d6 rounds
See invisible
Immune to fire, cold
Gate (30%): summon 1-2 lesser devils
Only damaged by silver or magic weapons
Fear immunity; paralyze lesser undead at will

fields.name: Cave Fisher
special: Filament: shoots sticky filament 60', Fort DC 12 or stuck (Str DC 16 to break)
Reel in: pulls stuck target 10'/round
Scuttles: immune to difficult terrain on rock/cave surfaces
Dangerous in packs: filaments can immobilize an entire party in 2 rounds

fields.name: Crypt Thing
special: Teleport others: on hit, target is teleported to a random dungeon room (Ref DC 14 to resist)
Undead: immunities
Anchor: cannot leave its crypt
Power of place: crypt thing has +2 to all rolls inside its crypt

fields.name: Demon Fly
special: Venomous bite: Fort DC 12 or paralyzed 1d4 rounds
Drone: all creatures within 10' must Fort DC 11 each round or be nauseated
Compound eyes: cannot be flanked; +4 to Perception

fields.name: Doppelganger
special: Shapeshift: can perfectly duplicate any humanoid seen; takes 1 round
Memory theft: on killing a target, can access its memories for 1 hour
Detect thoughts at will (30' range)
Immune to sleep and charm
If killed, melts into gray ooze revealing true form

fields.name: Giant Centipede
special: Poison: Fort DC 12 or take 1d6 Str damage over 1 round (Str 0 = death)
Climbing: moves on walls and ceilings at full speed
Swarm variant: 4 HD swarm, attacks everyone in 10' radius

fields.name: Giant Rat
special: Filth fever: Fort DC 9 each bite; fever onset 1d3 days, -2 Str/-2 Sta while diseased
Pack instinct: rats will not retreat while any rat in pack is fighting
Drowning surprise: attack as part of swimming; +2 to hit in water

fields.name: Grave Worm
special: Burrowing: moves through soil at 15'/round; creates tunnels 5' diameter
Acid trail: leaves slippery acid trail (Ref DC 10 or fall; 1d4 acid to fallen)
Sense of death: can smell dead flesh within 300'
Swallowed whole on crit: Fort DC 15 or swallowed (4d6 acid per round)

fields.name: Iron Cobra
special: Poison: Fort DC 13 or 2d6 Str over 1d4 rounds
Construct: immune to sleep, charm, hold; damaged only by +1 or better weapons
Track scent: follow a specific scent 1 mile regardless of terrain
Winding up: if spring is wound down (1d6 hits), it stops moving until rewound
